close_reason: Wire format is identical; Value::Null serializes the same as None<updatedProperties>.
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_changes (line ~93): the response includes 'updatedProperties': Value::Null as a hard-coded JSON value. RFC 8621 §2.2 says this field should be null when no partial-property tracking is available, which is correct. However, using Value::Null as a literal in the json\!() macro call is idiomatic — there is no real issue here beyond a code comment opportunity. Not filing this as a real finding; the pattern is fine. Noted to confirm no false positives.
title: UpdatedProperties always null — could be typed None rather than Value::Null
